name: greek-fire-constantinople
description: Byzantine ships sprayed a secret burning liquid that clung to water and set enemy fleets ablaze.

name: great-bombard-constantinople
description: A monstrous Ottoman cannon pounded the ancient defences of a great Christian capital until they fell.

name: leonardo-armoured-car
description: An Italian polymath drew a domed, cannon-bristling car driven by cranks, a forerunner of the tank.

name: nagashino-matchlock-volleys
description: Massed Japanese gunners fired in rotation from behind fences and shattered a famed samurai cavalry.

name: puckle-gun-patented
description: A London lawyer patented a tripod-mounted revolving flintlock, with round bullets for Christians and square for Turks.

name: first-aerial-bombing-libya
friendly_name: First Bomb Dropped from a Plane
description: An Italian pilot tossed small grenades by hand onto enemy troops in North Africa, opening aerial bombardment.

name: thompson-submachine-gun
description: The 'Tommy gun' with its drum magazine arrived, later famed in the hands of gangsters and soldiers.

name: spitfire-first-flight
description: A graceful elliptical-winged British fighter made its maiden flight and became a symbol of resistance.

name: dambusters-bouncing-bombs
description: Bombers skimmed low over reservoirs and released spinning bombs that skipped across water to burst German dams.

name: me-262-jet-fighter-combat
description: A swept-wing German aircraft with no propeller outpaced every Allied fighter in the sky.

name: ak-47-designed
description: A Soviet tank sergeant's simple, rugged assault rifle was finished and went on to become the most produced firearm.

name: b-52-enters-service
description: An eight-engined American bomber began a career that has outlasted nearly every other aircraft of its age.

name: m16-rifle-adopted
description: A light, black plastic-stocked American rifle replaced wooden-stocked designs and went to jungle war.

name: f-117-stealth-fighter-service
description: A faceted black American jet designed to be nearly invisible to radar became operational in secret.

name: b-2-stealth-bomber-first-flight
description: A huge flying-wing bomber, built to slip past air defences unseen, took to the air for the first time.

name: patriot-missiles-scuds
description: Television audiences watched anti-missile interceptors rise to meet incoming ballistic missiles over the Gulf.

name: predator-drone-first-hellfire
description: An unmanned American aircraft fired a Hellfire missile for the first time, turning a spy drone into a hunter-killer.

name: mother-of-all-bombs-combat
friendly_name: Mother of All Bombs Used in Combat
description: The largest non-nuclear bomb in the American arsenal was dropped in anger for the first time.
